chunks: And with the first chain of narration from 'Ali ibn Mahzyar, from al-Hasan, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said: I heard him say:
"Why do you cause grief to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family?!" A man said: "May I be your ransom, and how do we grieve him?"

He said: "Do you not know that your deeds are presented before him, and when he sees in them disobedience to Allah, it grieves him? So do not cause grief to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, and make him happy."

key_terms.أَعْمَالَكُمْ تُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهِ: your deeds are presented before him

ai.seo_question: Are our deeds presented to the Prophet Muhammad after his passing?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) admonishes his followers by revealing that the deeds of the believers are presented to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). When the Prophet sees sins among them, it causes him grief. This teaching was directed at the companions of the Imam, urging them to be mindful that their actions have a spiritual impact beyond this world, and to strive for righteousness so as to bring joy rather than sorrow to the Prophet.
word_analysis: and with the chain of narration
